name: Primordial Mist
oracle_text:
At the beginning of your end step, you may manifest the top card of your library. (Put it onto the battlefield face down as a 2/2 creature. Turn it face up any time for its mana cost if it's a creature card.)
Exile a face-down permanent you control face up: You may play that card this turn. (You still pay its costs. Timing rules still apply.)
blocked_sentences: Exile a face-down permanent you control face up: You may play that card this turn. (You still pay its costs. Timing rules still apply.)

needs.what: an activated-ability cost that exiles a permanent you control matching a selector (here a face-down one, exiled face up), bound with `as` so the ability's effects can read the exiled card -- the exile counterpart of `sacrifice`
needs.why_existing_wont_do: `cost_keys` exile only the source (`exile_self`), a card from hand (`exile_from_hand`, `exile_self_from_hand`) or a card from the graveyard (`exile_from_graveyard`); nothing exiles another permanent from the battlefield as a cost, and moving it into an `exile` op would shift payment to resolution and let the ability be activated without a face-down permanent

needs.what: a selector key matching face-down permanents (manifested, cloaked, morphed, disguised), e.g. `{zone: battlefield, controller: you, face_down: true}`, usable in the cost filter
needs.why_existing_wont_do: `selector_keys` has no face-down key; `face_down` exists only as an option on library/exile ops meaning private exile, not as a property a selector can read on a permanent

needs.what: "You may play that card this turn" over the card the cost exiled: `grant_playable` with `playable_this_turn` over a binding produced by the exile cost
needs.why_existing_wont_do: `grant_playable` can grant the permission, but no cost produces a binding naming the exiled card for it to read; `exile` with `playable_this_turn` would exile on resolution rather than as the cost
